امتلكوا (form VIII)
# اِمْتَلَكُوا (imtalakū) /im.ta.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# اُمْتُلِكُوا (umtulikū) /um.tu.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
# اِمْتَلِكُوا (imtalikū) /im.ta.li.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِمْتَلَكَ (imtalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
